title: Contemporaneous null simulation for volatility absorption (K897 timing fix)

seed_spec.note: Same seed + same n_obs + same params as K897 => simulated return paths are pointwise identical to K897's. h is extended one step (h[n_obs], which needs only eps[n_obs-1]) so no extra random draw is taken and no padding is used.

up_shock_bootstrap.note: The calm up-shock cell has only 10 days, so the up-only decline is imprecise. What the interval CAN establish is reported; what it cannot is not asserted.

paired_block_bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap of full day-level rows; pooled and up-only statistics use identical resampled blocks
paired_block_bootstrap.gate_rule: positive ambient-up calm-minus-high point estimate with primary 95% block CI excluding zero => absorption survives; CI containing zero => mechanism unresolved; otherwise absorption is not supported or direction is reversed

variant_spec.A: PRIMARY. contemporaneous proxy sqrt(h[t+1]); regime by level; shock |dP|>2
variant_spec.B: frequency-matched: per-path quantile shock threshold + per-path regime cut-points matched to empirical VIX regime probabilities
variant_spec.C: relative threshold |dP|/P_{t-1} > q, same unit-free q as empirical
variant_spec.D: sign-split: dP>+2 (vol up) vs dP<-2 (vol down); shared non-shock denominator
variant_spec.E: ambient regime: classify day t by the PRE-shock level P[t-1]
variant_spec.H: AMBIENT x SIGN: classify by P[t-1], split dP>+2 and dP<-2, and use the shared pooled non-shock denominator. Added by the Codex FAIL follow-up and run symmetrically on empirical data and the same-seed null paths
variant_spec.G: POST-HOC (not pre-registered): doubly-corrected -- ambient regime AND relative threshold, i.e. B/C/E's fixes combined (independent review M2)
variant_spec.F: POST-HOC (not pre-registered): VRP-calibrated -- affine-map the null proxy onto VIX's scale (VIX ~ a + b*P fitted on real data), THEN apply the paper's literal thresholds
variant_spec.k897_lagged: REPLICATION ARM: K897's proxy sqrt(h[t]) on the same paths (internal placebo)

pre_registered_decision_rule.outside_95_ci: identification HOLDS and strengthens; paper upgrades
pre_registered_decision_rule.inside_95_ci: absorption claim DOWNGRADED to mechanical decomposition; paper reframes
pre_registered_decision_rule.committed_before_results: git commit 870af5d00 (README pre-registration, no results present)

codex_fail_followup_rule.statistic: ambient(VIX_{t-1}) x up-shock SAR decline = calm minus high
codex_fail_followup_rule.inference: paired circular moving-block bootstrap, primary block=20 trading days, sensitivity blocks 10/20/40/63, B=10000
codex_fail_followup_rule.positive_ci_excluding_zero: absorption survives the ambient fear-shock gate; JBF line may continue
codex_fail_followup_rule.ci_including_zero: mechanism unresolved; paper must be downgraded/reframed

variant_F_calibration_note.why: The affine map that removes the variance-risk-premium level gap has slope b=0.691 < 1, so it also COMPRESSES daily increments: a 2-point move on VIX's scale needs |dP| > 2.89 in the null's own units. Calm-regime shocks then fall below the minimum cell size in every path, and the null's overall shock rate collapses to ~0.06 vs the data's 0.151. So F fixes the LEVEL but breaks the INCREMENT scale. No single affine recalibration matches VIX in both -- there is no calibration-invariant null for this statistic. That is a property of the SAR design, not a coding failure, and it is reported rather than dropped.

mechanism_diagnostic_within_regime_shock.note: A fixed absolute threshold on a mean-reverting vol proxy becomes progressively EASIER to cross as the level rises, because the decay term itself moves more than 2 annualised points. Where the null's within-regime shock rate runs far above the data's, the null's shock bucket is being flooded with ordinary days and its SAR is pushed toward 1 -- a decline produced by selection, not by absorption.

down_shock_impossibility.note: With alpha=0 the deepest one-day fall the null can produce is pure decay, h_next = omega + beta*h. That crosses -2 annualised points only above 28.84. Below it a vol-DOWN shock cannot exist in this null AT ALL. The empirical decline, however, is carried ENTIRELY by vol-DOWN days (see the sign-split): the null has no such channel, so on the down side the null and the data are not even measuring the same event. D_down's n_valid_sims=0 in calm/normal/elevated is therefore a structural property of the null, not a silent failure.

calibration_diagnostics.note: VIX carries a variance risk premium, so its level sits above the physical conditional vol of the GARCH null. Under fixed thresholds (variant A) the simulation therefore over-populates the calm regime relative to the data. Variant B removes this by matching regime occupancy and shock rate by construction.

variant_disagreement.the_null_comparison_is_INCONCLUSIVE: The variants split. Worse, the pre-registered primary's own non-rejection is not strong evidence: the mechanism diagnostic shows variant A's null manufactures its 0.619 decline by letting plain decay cross the fixed 2-point threshold at high vol levels (null within-regime shock rate 0.82 at crisis vs the data's 0.54), which is NOT how the decline arises in the data. A's 'pass' is one artifact cancelling another. The corrected nulls (B frequency-matched, C relative-threshold, G doubly-corrected) all reject. So neither 'the decline is pure GARCH mechanics' NOR 'the decline is absorption' is established by the null comparison. It is inconclusive, and saying otherwise in either direction would be overclaiming.
variant_disagreement.why_no_null_can_settle_the_down_side: Below 28.8 annualised points this null cannot produce a vol-DOWN shock AT ALL (alpha=0 => the deepest one-day fall is pure decay). But the empirical decline is carried ENTIRELY by vol-DOWN days. On the down side the null and the data are not even measuring the same event, so where B/C/G reject, what they detect is the ABSENCE OF A RELIEF-RALLY CHANNEL IN GARCH -- not the PRESENCE OF ABSORPTION IN MARKETS.

paired_block_bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap of full day-level rows; pooled and up-only statistics use identical resampled blocks
paired_block_bootstrap.gate_rule: positive ambient-up calm-minus-high point estimate with primary 95% block CI excluding zero => absorption survives; CI containing zero => mechanism unresolved; otherwise absorption is not supported or direction is reversed

null_free_evidence.finding: Current-VIX sign split gives up-only decline -0.1192, but that post-shock regime definition is endogenous and cannot decide the ambient mechanism. The required ambient(VIX_t-1) x up-shock decline is 1.0465; its primary 20-day paired block-bootstrap CI is [0.3286, 1.7625]. The direct paired pooled-minus-up-current contrast is 0.9353 with CI [0.3437, 1.4991]; this replaces the invalid comparison of an up-only CI endpoint with the pooled point estimate.
null_free_evidence.inference_boundary: The paired bootstrap establishes only the registered ambient-up gate and the pooled-minus-up contrast. It does not by itself identify a structural causal channel.

pre_registered_primary_detail: Empirical decline 0.8165 falls INSIDE the contemporaneous null 95% CI [0.0824, 1.0596] (MC p=0.409759). A GJR-GARCH with no absorption mechanism, once its vol proxy is made contemporaneous with returns the way VIX is, reproduces the observed SAR decline. Per the pre-registered rule the absorption claim is DOWNGRADED to a mechanical decomposition of fixed-threshold selection plus same-day co-movement; K897's NULL REJECTED verdict does not survive the timing fix.
verdict_detail: The omitted ambient(VIX_t-1) x fear-shock specification reverses the earlier D_up reading. Its empirical calm-minus-high decline is 1.0465 with a primary 20-day paired block-bootstrap 95% CI [0.3286, 1.7625], strictly positive under the fixed follow-up rule. The absorption mechanism therefore survives this empirical gate; the prior FRL downgrade is not supported by K1686 alone. The same-seed GJR null comparison is reported separately (empirical 1.0465, null CI [-0.6554, 0.9887], MC p=0.032673) and remains subject to the documented level/increment calibration failures. The direct paired pooled-minus-current-up contrast is 0.9353 with CI [0.3437, 1.4991]; no inference is made by comparing separate intervals.
